items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Jimmy McPartland) does not mention Herb Sanford; the relationship is established only through the interviewer reading a column written by Sanford about McPartland.

ctx.x: Here's another reprint from the International Musician and a column by Herb Sanford. And the whole column is about Jimmy McPartland, horn man. (LAUGHTER). And this is very recent. It says, jazz is 1970 is very much alive. And he says, that he stopped in at/Mike's Curtain Call on West 52nd Street and heard the real thing. And there was Jimmy McPartland, the horn man, whose great cornet has woven an affectionate and permanent thread in the story of jazz music. We hear the beautiful sound, the tasteful facing, the…
